text: Implemented identity-precision and crossnobis reduced relation fits whose identity covers source/preparation, design, measurement, metric, and normalization. One fit now yields pair-labeled RDM, typed distance, rank RSA, partial RSA, and regression RSA without reopening evidence. Signal/nuisance roles are phantom-typed; exact second-order estimands and fit identity are retained. JVM+JS RelationalFitSuite 3/3 and RelationalRsaSuite 4/4.
